test_title: PYST 20: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 18 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, T, U, V, W, X, Y, and D, are sitting around a circular table, facing the center. Only two people are sitting between X and U when counted from X's right. Only three people are sitting between Y and W when counted from W's right. U is sitting immediately to the right of W. D is sitting immediately to the right of T. Who is sitting fourth to the right of V?
solution:
Given: Seven people, T, U, V, W, X, Y, and D, are sitting around a circular table, facing the center.

1) Only two people are sitting between X and U when counted from X's right.

2) Only three people are sitting between Y and W when counted from W's right.

3) U is sitting immediately to the right of W.

4) D is sitting immediately to the right of T. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78a3ae2f47133dff511b4164ddb90dc0560b99510ed6fe325fabe2667f0bb82c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31b800a0aa28558477cbeb31943d219b7f948c0224171a414ed4e4a3ce04d64e.png] 

Here, **D** is sitting fourth to the right of V.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
